def q1(label, q):
    try:
        d = sql(q)
        out(label)
        for r in d.itertuples(index=False):
            out('   ', *[x for x in r])
    except Exception as e:
        out(label, 'FAILED:', str(e)[:200])
q1('tfn.s34 by report year: filers, rows, last file date',
   "select extract(year from rdate)::int y, count(distinct mgrno) mgrs, count(*) n, max(fdate) last_fdate from tfn.s34 where rdate >= '2009-12-31' and rdate = fdate group by 1 order by 1")
q1('tfn.s34 report dates in the latest file dates',
   "select fdate, min(rdate) min_r, max(rdate) max_r, count(distinct mgrno) mgrs from tfn.s34 where fdate >= '2025-01-01' group by 1 order by 1")
q1('crsp.msf_v2 last month', "select max(mthcaldt) from crsp.msf_v2")
q1('crsp mutual fund returns: last month and funds', "select max(caldt), count(distinct crsp_fundno) from crsp.monthly_tna_ret_nav where caldt >= '2024-01-01'")
q1('tfn.s12 by report year: funds, rows', "select extract(year from rdate)::int y, count(distinct fundno) f, count(*) n from tfn.s12 where rdate >= '2019-12-31' group by 1 order by 1")
q1('comp.sec_shortint range', "select min(datadate), max(datadate), count(distinct gvkey) from comp.sec_shortint")
q1('comp.g_secd: last date', "select max(datadate) from comp.g_secd where datadate >= '2025-06-01'")
q1('global factor data: last month, countries', "select max(eom), count(distinct excntry) from contrib_global_factor.global_factor where eom >= '2025-01-01'")
